ev_shrine.title: 神秘祭壇
ev_shrine.desc: 一座散發微光的祭壇，似乎可以獻祭些什麼來換取力量。

options.label: 獻上10%當前HP
options.result_text: 你感覺力量湧入體內！（接下來3層攻擊力+15%）
options.result_text_en: You feel power surging through your body! (ATK +15% for the next 3 floors)

options.label: 獻上100金幣
options.result_text: 祭壇之光包覆你，HP/MP完全恢復。
options.result_text_en: The altar's light envelops you, fully restoring your HP/MP.

options.label: 不予理會
options.result_text: 你選擇謹慎離開，什麼都沒發生。
options.result_text_en: You decide to cautiously leave. Nothing happens.

ev_shrine.desc_en: A faintly glowing altar that seems willing to trade an offering for power.

ev_trapped_chest.title: 上鎖的箱子
ev_trapped_chest.desc: 一個鎖得死死的箱子，鎖孔周圍似乎有些可疑的機關痕跡。

options.label: 付50金幣請鎖匠工具開鎖
options.result_text: 鎖輕巧地彈開，裡面似乎裝著一些補給品。
options.result_text_en: The lock pops open smoothly. Inside seem to be some supplies.

options.label: 直接暴力撬開
options.result_text: 機關彈出扎了你一下，但箱子裡有200金幣！
options.label_en: Force it open by brute strength
options.result_text_en: A hidden mechanism springs out and pricks you, but the chest holds 200 gold!

options.label: 放著不管
options.result_text: 你決定別冒這個險。
options.result_text_en: You decide not to risk it.

ev_trapped_chest.desc_en: A tightly locked chest, with suspicious trap marks around the keyhole.

ev_wandering_merchant.title: 深淵裡的流浪商人
ev_wandering_merchant.desc: 一個打扮怪異的商人蹲坐在角落，向你招手兜售著什麼。

options.label: 付80金幣買藥水
options.result_text: 商人塞給你一瓶不知名的藥水，轉眼消失在黑暗中。
options.result_text_en: The merchant presses an unmarked potion into your hands, then vanishes into the darkness.

options.label: 不理他繼續前進
options.result_text: 你加快腳步走過，沒有回頭。
options.result_text_en: You quicken your pace and walk past without looking back.

ev_wandering_merchant.desc_en: An oddly dressed merchant crouches in the corner, waving you over to sell something.

ev_cursed_fountain.title: 詛咒的噴泉
ev_cursed_fountain.desc: 噴泉裡的水泛著詭異的紫光，喝下去似乎會有奇怪的效果。

options.label: 喝下噴泉水
options.result_text: 一陣噁心感後，你的皮膚浮現出淡淡的符文（接下來3層防禦力+20%）。
options.result_text_en: After a wave of nausea, faint runes appear on your skin (DEF +20% for the next 3 floors).

options.label: 不敢嘗試
options.result_text: 你決定還是不要拿命開玩笑。
options.result_text_en: You decide not to gamble with your life.

ev_cursed_fountain.desc_en: The water in the fountain glows with an eerie purple light. Drinking it might have strange effects.

ev_lost_adventurer.title: 受傷的冒險者
ev_lost_adventurer.desc: 一名渾身是傷的冒險者倒在地上，虛弱地向你求助。

options.label: 給他一瓶生命藥水
options.result_text: 他感激地塞給你身上剩下的150金幣作為報答後離開。
options.result_text_en: Gratefully, he hands you the remaining 150 gold he had as thanks, then leaves.

options.label: 視而不見地離開
options.result_text: 你選擇優先確保自己的安全。
options.result_text_en: You choose to prioritize your own safety.

ev_lost_adventurer.desc_en: An adventurer covered in wounds lies on the ground, weakly calling out for help.

ev_gamble_table.title: 詭異的賭桌
ev_gamble_table.desc: 一張無人看守的賭桌憑空出現，籌碼自己滾動著，似乎在邀請你下注。

options.label: 穩健下注50金幣
options.result_text: 籌碼停在你這邊，贏得90金幣。
options.label_en: Place a safe bet of 50 gold
options.result_text_en: The chips land in your favor — you win 90 gold.

options.label: All-in 200金幣
options.result_text: 桌子發出詭異的笑聲，你贏得500金幣的鉅獎！
options.result_text_en: The table lets out an eerie laugh — you win a massive jackpot of 500 gold!

options.label: 不賭，安全第一
options.result_text: 你拍了拍灰塵走開。
options.result_text_en: You brush off the dust and walk away.

ev_gamble_table.desc_en: An unattended gambling table appears out of nowhere, its chips rolling on their own as if inviting you to place a bet.

ev_collapsing_floor.title: 崩塌的地板
ev_collapsing_floor.desc: 前方的地板出現裂痕，似乎隨時會塌陷，但裂縫深處閃著金光。

options.label: 硬著頭皮衝過去拿寶物
options.result_text: 地板塌陷的瞬間你抓住了金幣袋，雖然摔得不輕，但賺到了220金幣！
options.label_en: Brace yourself and rush in for the treasure
options.result_text_en: Just as the floor collapses, you snatch the bag of gold. The fall hurts, but you've earned 220 gold!

options.label: 小心繞道而行
options.result_text: 你選擇安全地繞過去，什麼都沒拿到。
options.result_text_en: You safely go around, getting nothing.

ev_collapsing_floor.desc_en: Cracks spread across the floor ahead, looking ready to give way any moment, but a golden glow flickers deep within the cracks.

ev_spirit_whisper.title: 靈魂的低語
ev_spirit_whisper.desc: 空氣中傳來模糊的低語聲，似乎想用你身上的某個東西交換指引。

options.label: 獻上一個解毒草
options.result_text: 低語化作一道氣流鑽進你的武器（接下來2層攻擊力+10%）。
options.result_text_en: The whisper becomes a gust of air that seeps into your weapon (ATK +10% for the next 2 floors).

options.label: 不予回應
options.result_text: 低語聲漸漸消散，你繼續前進。
options.result_text_en: The whispering gradually fades away, and you continue onward.

ev_spirit_whisper.desc_en: A faint whisper drifts through the air, as if wanting to trade something of yours for guidance.

ev_blood_pact.title: 血契石碑
ev_blood_pact.desc: 石碑上刻著古老的契約文字，似乎能用大量的血換取強大的力量。

options.label: 獻上25%當前HP立下血契
options.result_text: 血契生效，你感覺自己變得異常狂暴（接下來4層攻擊力+30%）。
options.label_en: Offer 25% of current HP to seal the blood pact
options.result_text_en: The blood pact takes hold, and you feel an unnatural rage building within (ATK +30% for the next 4 floors).

options.label: 拒絕這種瘋狂的交易
options.result_text: 你轉身離開了這座不祥的石碑。
options.result_text_en: You turn and walk away from the ominous stone tablet.

ev_blood_pact.desc_en: Ancient contract text is carved into the tablet, seemingly offering great power in exchange for a large amount of blood.

ev_mirror_self.title: 鏡像試煉
ev_mirror_self.desc: 一面巨大的鏡子映出你自己的倒影，倒影開口要求你付出代價以獲得試煉的獎勵。

options.label: 付150金幣完成試煉
options.result_text: 鏡子碎裂，留下了一張技能卷軸。
options.label_en: Pay 150 gold to complete the trial
options.result_text_en: The mirror shatters, leaving behind a skill scroll.

options.label: 打破鏡子離開
options.result_text: 鏡子應聲碎裂，沒有任何事發生。
options.result_text_en: The mirror shatters at once. Nothing happens.

ev_mirror_self.desc_en: A great mirror reflects your own image, and the reflection speaks, demanding a price in exchange for the trial's reward.
